analysis: EXP-005 dev-batch-2 corpus sufficiency (evidence layer, not a generation metric)

classes.STORED_TEXT_SUFFICIENT: the stored headline and excerpt keep what the full source says about the question, as far as the check shows
classes.STORED_TEXT_INSUFFICIENT: the full source holds question-relevant text that the stored headline and excerpt omit
classes.SOURCE_CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE: the relevant source content could not be assessed as text (for example, images)

method: Each page was fetched once over HTTPS with a plain GET (curl, compressed transfer decoded). Script and style blocks were removed and tags stripped to get visible text. A case-insensitive term pattern was counted in the visible text and in the stored headline plus excerpt. Only counts, sizes and SHA-256 fingerprints are recorded here. No article text is stored in this repository. Pages can change after the fetch, so the fingerprints identify what was checked.
not_checked: Items not listed here were not fetched. Images were not inspected. Term counts can miss paraphrase (for example, a shoe described without the word).
